text: RESULTS: Biopsy Findings: Cells with nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within the follicle-bearing epithelium. speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings confirm the presence of malignant cells, and with your negative infectious disease panel and heavy smoking history, the diagnosis is clear. DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
